case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your quote. We have read your remarks on the cost indices carefully.

Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 117.97; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 120.50; new price valid from 2027-01-01; payment 14 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 121.02; new price valid from 2027-01-01; payment 30 days net.

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We take your quality feedback seriously and are continuously improving our processes to uphold the high standards you expect from our foundry. Building on our longstanding connection, our current proposal stands at a price of €134.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Building on your third option, we can offer a revised price of €134.90 per unit, maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, valid from 1 January 2027. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to return to the 1 November 2026 effective date. Our current offer is a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. As a family-run foundry, extending payment to 60 days is difficult, so we ask to maintain 30-day terms as a trade. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms, with a price of €133.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. We deeply value our long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the strong relationship we have built with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. However, we are willing to accept your requested 60-day payment terms to support our long-standing cooperation. 

With this accommodation, we can offer a unit price of €133.90 per unit. For this updated Angebot, we set a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We take great pride in the quality of the work from our foundry and its dedicated people, and we are glad we could find a way forward together. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued movement and your commitment to finding a fair solution. As a family-run foundry, we deeply value the trust built between our companies over many years of close cooperation.

To support our long-standing partnership, we can offer a further concession to a price of €133.50 per unit, maintaining the 60-day payment terms and 1 November 2026 effective date. This represents a significant step from our side, and we trust it brings us closer to an agreement.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. For your planning, our Angebot remains valid for 7 days. Our full Angebot details stand at a price of €133.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
